highlights: Led delivery across user, payments, IM, e-commerce, and operations platforms; owned architecture reviews, work breakdown, quality, releases, and mentoring.
Drove AI applications and frontend platform initiatives, integrating Dify, MCP, and low-code capabilities; owned technical design, frontend integration, and cross-team delivery.
Proposed interaction and technical improvements; contributed to requirements, product design, and delivery, and initiated AI projects from design through business rollout.

Built PC and mobile industrial data-visualization interfaces with ECharts and D3.js; added chart editing and multi-screen layouts, constrained concurrent rendering, and rasterized selected charts to reduce out-of-memory risk.

aiProjects.name: Qunjielong Operations Decision Agent
aiProjects.summary: Built an operations decision Agent for group-buying hosts, unifying diagnosis, product selection, assisted selling, and after-sales tasks across multiple admin systems into a natural-language workflow. Addressed informal input, long business chains, tool scale, and context loss with Agent orchestration and shared state.
bullets: Agent orchestration: designed an Agent scheduler and domain-task execution model, splitting diagnosis, product selection, assisted selling, and after-sales into independently executable business units.

Intent understanding: combined rules, vector retrieval, and LLM classification for colloquial, abbreviated, and multi-intent queries; added clarification, rejection, and slot completion; reached 92% intent accuracy.

Context and replanning: layered system rules, task state, tool results, and user preferences, loading context by task stage and recomputing only affected steps when inventory, price, or goals changed.

Tool governance and evaluation: connected business systems through MCP and Tool Calling; filtered tools by role, scenario, and risk, with permissions, idempotency, audit, and result feedback; achieved 95% tool-selection success, 4.8s P95 latency, and 87% end-to-end task success.

aiProjects.name: Qunjielong AI Business Applications
aiProjects.summary: Built two business applications with Dify: a customer-service knowledge base and a product-selection calendar, turning service records and business metrics into conversational capabilities.
bullets: Business MCP server: built a Node.js MCP server with the MCP SDK, exposing activity, homepage, order, product, and assisted-selling capabilities via tool definitions and parameter mappings.

Customer-service knowledge base: curated 1,970 records with labels, role segmentation, and chunking; configured data lookup, slot completion, and human handoff, then sampled historical queries to validate results.
Product-selection calendar: combined metric lookup with product analysis through Dify Webapp and MCP; extended the chat UI and generated request/response types with openapi-typescript.

workProjects.name: Qunjielong Mini Program
workProjects.summary: For a social-commerce platform with hundreds of millions of RMB in monthly GMV and 1M daily active users; delivered Mini Program, PC, operations-console, and Flutter experiences.
bullets: Build acceleration: optimized incremental builds, caching, and package size, cutting startup from 5–8 minutes to under 90 seconds; added TypeScript/UI unit tests with 60%+ coverage.
Core journeys: iterated virtualization, page loading, and CLS; led IM, home, and checkout refactors, and owned Flutter architecture plus embedded-H5 white-screen tracing.
GEO and BFF: staticized Angular public pages with structured data, sitemap, and llms.txt for AI answer engines; built Node.js aggregation APIs with unified error results.

workProjects.name: Daka Alliance
workProjects.summary: Integrated with the WeChat Store ecosystem to help suppliers acquire more customers; built the PC site and operations console across product marketplace, sourcing, traceability, and product-detail workflows.
bullets: Multi-app architecture: managed the PC site and operations console in a Monorepo, sharing components, modules, and API types.
Complex forms: split state, field dependencies, validation, and submission by module; guarded routes with React Router, AuthGuard, and roles.

workProjects.name: Lexing Automotive Business Platform
workProjects.summary: Delivered multiple platforms for Aite Good Car and Leying Car across dealer tools, automotive content, orders, payments, logistics, and finance.
bullets: Multi-platform delivery: led Aite Good Car PC, H5, and Mini Program with Nuxt SSR, keeping first paint under 600ms and ranking model-keyword pages in Bing and Google top 1–3.
Stability: production logs, analytics, and Sentry; split the frontend monolith and optimized Webpack, cutting builds from 10 minutes to under 2.

personalProjects.name: VideoNote: Multimodal Video Notes
bullets: Multimodal pipeline: chained FFmpeg, ASR, key-frame extraction, and VLM/LLM into structured, searchable, question-answerable video notes.
Resumable long tasks and model abstraction: persisted stage checkpoints so failed tasks resume without rework, and abstracted model providers plus vector retrieval for local fallback.
